title: VST ECS expands storage portfolio with SkyHawk and IronWolf drives for Philippine businesses
summary: VST ECS Phils., Inc., the leading ICT distributor in the Philippines, has added SkyHawk™ AI and IronWolf® Pro hard drives to its storage portfolio as part of an expanded engagement with Seagate…

blocks.text: VST ECS Phils., Inc., the leading ICT distributor in the Philippines, has added SkyHawk™ AI and IronWolf® Pro hard drives to its storage portfolio as part of an expanded engagement with Seagate Technology, LLC, a global mass-capacity data storage leader. The two companies marked the occasion with a ceremonial handshake on October 20, 2026, the first day of the VST ECS CXO Tech Summit 2026 at Shangri-La Boracay. The new lines join the Exos enterprise drives VST ECS already distributes in the country. Joyce Lim, ASEAN Business Lead for the brand, joined VST ECS executives on stage: Angela Go, Director and Vice President for Operations; Cherry Centeno, First Vice President and Group General Manager, Value Business; and Ana Aliamante, Sales and Marketing Manager, Network Technology Group 4.

blocks.caption: VST ECS and Seagate Technology, LLC seal their expanded partnership with a ceremonial handshake at the VST ECS CXO Tech Summit 2026 at Shangri-La Boracay on October 20, 2026. blocks.text: The move comes as Philippine businesses depend more on round-the-clock storage. Video-imaging and analytics systems are now standard in malls, offices, warehouses and schools, often with AI analytics on top. More firms also rely on NAS systems to centralize and manage business data as part of broader data-protection and resilience strategies. Purpose-built drives such as SkyHawk and IronWolf drives are designed for the workload and operating requirements of video and NAS environments.

SkyHawk AI drives are designed for AI video analytics systems and can support up to 64 HD cameras and 32 additional AI streams. IronWolf Pro drives are built for commercial and enterprise RAID storage solutions of up to 24 bays and workloads of up to 550TB a year. Both lines offer capacities of up to 32TB, run 24/7, and come with a five-year limited warranty and three years of Rescue Data Recovery Services.
With SkyHawk AI, IronWolf Pro and Exos™ under one roof, partners can cover a client’s video analystics, enterprise NAS and server needs through a single distributor.

“Every transaction, camera feed and shared file adds to the data a business generates each day, and that volume keeps climbing,” said Jimmy Go, President and CEO, VST ECS Phils., Inc. “AI is pushing it even further, since it needs vast amounts of data to learn from and creates even more as it runs. That makes storage just as critical as the AI tools themselves. The data an organization keeps today is what will let it harness AI tomorrow. With SkyHawk and IronWolf now in our portfolio alongside Exos, we can provide our customers and partners with complete storage for video analaytics, NAS and enterprise servers, so organizations can build on their data with confidence.”

Seagate SkyHawk and IronWolf drives are available now through VST ECS and its authorized resellers nationwide. For inquiries, contact Lei Redillas, Product Manager at VST ECS Phils., Inc., at LRedillas@msi-ecs.com.ph, or reach out to your VST ECS sales representative.
